title: Preventing early-onset colorectal cancer
summary: The BMBF-funded collaborative project PEARL aims to gain new insights into the understanding of risk factors and causes of colorectal cancer in young adults <50 years (early-onset colorectal cancer [EOCRC]) in order to develop and evaluate effective strategies for primary and secondary prevention in this age group. The consortium is conducting a large population-based case-control study of EOCRC in Germany with 800 colorectal cancer cases and 800 non-colorectal cancer control subjects aged 18-49 years.

interventions.name: Patients with a colorectal cancer diagnosis between 18-49 years of age.
Control persons without a colorectal cancer diagnosis between 18-49 years of age.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- First-ever colorectal cancer (ICD-10: C18-20)
- Age at diagnosis 18-49 years
- Date of diagnosis max. 1 year before
- Sufficient knowledge of the German language
- Residence in Germany
- Healthwise able to participate in a study
- Ability to give consent
Exclusion criteria:
Participants who are found not to have met the inclusion criteria after all information is available will be excluded from the study analyses.
